to go sailing he classifies each day in July as windy or calm. Given that a day in July is
calm, the probability that the next day is calm is 0.9 . Given that a day in July is windy, the

(b) Find the probability that the 3rd July is calm. [2]
(c) Find the probability that the 1st July was calm given that the 3rd July is windy. [4]
